index|job_wait_events_job|job_wait_events|CREATE INDEX job_wait_events_job ON job_wait_events(job_id, seq)
index|jobs_claim|jobs|CREATE INDEX jobs_claim ON jobs(status, lane, id)
index|jobs_dedupe|jobs|CREATE INDEX jobs_dedupe ON jobs(dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL
index|jobs_settled|jobs|CREATE INDEX jobs_settled ON jobs(settled_at_ms) WHERE settled_at_ms IS NOT NULL
index|link_records_x_status_id|link_records|CREATE INDEX link_records_x_status_id ON link_records(x_status_id)
index|link_records_yt_video_id|link_records|CREATE INDEX link_records_yt_video_id ON link_records(yt_video_id)

index|path_lineage_from|path_lineage|CREATE INDEX path_lineage_from ON path_lineage(from_path, seq)

table|api_usage|api_usage|CREATE TABLE api_usage (
    service  TEXT NOT NULL,
    day      TEXT NOT NULL,
    units    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (service, day)
)
table|dup_labels|dup_labels|CREATE TABLE dup_labels (
         id                         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
         keep_path                  TEXT NOT NULL,
         other_path                 TEXT NOT NULL,
         keep_identity              TEXT,
         other_identity             TEXT,
         containment_keep_in_other  REAL NOT NULL,
         containment_other_in_keep  REAL NOT NULL,
         identity_match             INTEGER NOT NULL,
         verdict                    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('not-duplicates', 'keep')),
         at_ms                      INTEGER NOT NULL
     )
table|ignored_ids|ignored_ids|CREATE TABLE ignored_ids (
    kind    TEXT NOT NULL,
    id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    at_ms   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (kind, id)
)
table|image_descriptions|image_descriptions|CREATE TABLE image_descriptions (
    md5               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind              TEXT NOT NULL,
    narrative         TEXT NOT NULL,
    extraction        TEXT NOT NULL,
    description_hash  TEXT NOT NULL,
    described_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    raw               TEXT NOT NULL
)
table|job_attempt_times|job_attempt_times|CREATE TABLE job_attempt_times (
    job_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    claimed_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    settled_ms  INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (job_id, attempt)
)
table|job_step_checkpoints|job_step_checkpoints|CREATE TABLE job_step_checkpoints (
    job_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_index  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    outcome     TEXT NOT NULL,
    at_ms       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (job_id, step_index)
)
table|job_step_times|job_step_times|CREATE TABLE job_step_times (
    job_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    step_index  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    step_kind   TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_ms    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    end_ms      INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (job_id, attempt, step_index)
)
table|job_wait_events|job_wait_events|CREATE TABLE job_wait_events (
    seq       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    at_ms     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cause     TEXT NOT NULL,
    blocker   TEXT,
    until_ms  INTEGER
)
table|jobs|jobs|CREATE TABLE jobs (
    id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    job_type        TEXT NOT NULL,
    lane            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL,
    dedupe_key      TEXT,
    params          TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_keys   TEXT NOT NULL,
    service         TEXT,
    created_ms      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    claim_token     TEXT,
    claimed_at_ms   INTEGER,
    defer_until_ms  INTEGER,
    settled_at_ms   INTEGER,
    attempts        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    error           TEXT,
    failure_reason  TEXT,
    failure_kind    TEXT,
    notes           TEXT
, cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tel_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, first_claimed_ms INTEGER, last_claimed_ms INTEGER, tel_partial INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
table|link_records|link_records|CREATE TABLE link_records (
    canonical_url        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    url                  TEXT NOT NULL,
    domain               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    source_notes         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    first_seen           TEXT,
    last_seen            TEXT,
    state                TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    discovery_method     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scan',
    tracked_source       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'false',
    tracked_source_type  TEXT,
    tracked_source_note  TEXT,
    referred_material    TEXT,
    decision_reason      TEXT,
    yt_video_id          TEXT,
    x_status_id          TEXT
)
table|mail_boilerplate|mail_boilerplate|CREATE TABLE mail_boilerplate (
         source_key  TEXT NOT NULL,
         line_key    INTEGER NOT NULL,
         count       INTEGER NOT NULL,
         PRIMARY KEY (source_key, line_key)
     )
table|mail_boilerplate_seen|mail_boilerplate_seen|CREATE TABLE mail_boilerplate_seen (
         source_key  TEXT NOT NULL,
         message_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
         PRIMARY KEY (source_key, message_id)
     )
table|path_lineage|path_lineage|CREATE TABLE path_lineage (
    seq        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('created', 'renamed', 'replaced', 'deleted')),
    from_path  TEXT NOT NULL,
    to_path    TEXT,
    at_ms      INTEGER NOT NULL
)
table|path_lineage_floor|path_lineage_floor|CREATE TABLE path_lineage_floor (
    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    pruned  INTEGER NOT NULL
)
table|schedule_runs|schedule_runs|CREATE TABLE schedule_runs (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    last_run_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL
)
table|service_health|service_health|CREATE TABLE service_health (
    service               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    state                 TEXT NOT NULL,
    failure_score         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    open_count            INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_kind             TEXT,
    last_reason           TEXT,
    opened_at_ms          INTEGER,
    retry_at_ms           INTEGER,
    probe_acquired_at_ms  INTEGER
)
table|sqlite_sequence|sqlite_sequence|CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
table|tracker_items|tracker_items|CREATE TABLE tracker_items (
    source_kind    TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    title          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    url            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    first_seen_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    day            TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('line', 'note', 'ignored', 'skipped')),
    score          REAL,
    full_body      INTEGER, note_path TEXT, source_name TEXT, duration_s INTEGER, word_count INTEGER, status TEXT, access TEXT, complete INTEGER, full_word_count INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (source_kind, source_key, item_id)
)
table|trash_entries|trash_entries|CREATE TABLE trash_entries (
         id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
         location       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (location IN ('vault', 'system')),
         trash_path     TEXT NOT NULL,
         original_path  TEXT NOT NULL,
         trashed_ms     INTEGER NOT NULL,
         bytes          INTEGER NOT NULL,
         reason         TEXT NOT NULL
             CHECK (reason IN ('deleted', 'replaced', 'note-attachment', 'orphan', 'seeded')),
         mtime_ms       INTEGER,
         inode          INTEGER,
         info_name      TEXT
     )
